_comment: Metadata ABOUT the original game files. The files themselves are never
committed -- see binary/README.md. This is the convention used by
OpenTTD (media/baseset/*.obg): describe the copyrighted data precisely
enough to verify and locate it, without redistributing any of it.

game.title: New Star Soccer 5
game.origin: Purchase on Steam (appid 212780), then run scripts/setup.py.

NSS5.exe.note: The reconstruction target. Every byte comparison is made against this.

steamstub.dll.note: Ships with the retail install. Steam integration is stripped from the reconstruction.

IRClipboardFunctions.dll.note: Ships with the retail install. Not used by the rebuild.
